verdict.rationale: Skyvern's SDK connects to its cloud Chromium over CDP and layers Playwright on top. Developers can drive the cloud browser with Playwright and fall back to selectors, so Playwright-style code can run against Skyvern's browsers. However, nothing documents attaching an arbitrary existing Playwright, Puppeteer or raw CDP client to a Skyvern browser via an exposed endpoint. Missing for 10: a documented CDP/WebSocket endpoint for external clients, Puppeteer support, explicit migration of existing scripts without rewriting, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can connect my existing Playwright, Puppeteer, or CDP automation code to the product's browsers instead of rewriting it

citations.quote: The Skyvern SDK connects to a cloud Chromium instance over CDP, layers Playwright on top, and injects AI into every page interaction.
Drop-in AI commands on top of Playwright. Use natural language to act, extract, and validate — or fall back to selectors.
Drive a cloud browser from Python or TypeScript with AI actions and Playwright
